pairs.l: 1 — I know I promised to join you at the party, but I won't be able to make it.
2 — I don't want you to carry the furniture alone. I'll be back by 5.
3 — She must be out of reach, but I'm sure she'll call soon.
4 — I may sound strict, but you're staying in and that's final.
5 — It would be stupid to give up the project now that you're almost done.

r1.exp: Poruka 1 (ne mogu doći na zabavu) = C (Sorry I can't go). Poruka 2 (ne nosite namještaj sami, čekajte me) = E (Wait for me). Poruka 3 (ne brini, sigurno će nazvati) = D (Don't worry). Poruka 4 (ostaješ kod kuće, konačno) = F (You can't go). Poruka 5 (glupo bi bilo odustati sad kad si gotovo završio) = B (Carry on).

r6.exp: 'Peter is organising a SLEEPOVER AT HIS HOME this weekend' → Michael je kod Petra = C (At a friend's house).

r7.exp: 'My parents KEEP ON TELLING me to get out of the house and get a job, and I've had ENOUGH OF THAT' → uzima posao zbog roditelja = B.

r8.exp: 'SKETCHING in museums and galleries to learn about historical periods and STYLES' = studij likovne umjetnosti = A (Art).

r9.exp: 'Got an old one FOR £8' → potrošio je £8 ovog posjeta = A. Novi CD (£12) će kupiti sljedeći tjedan.

r10.exp: 'He's taking me with him to STUDY FRENCH' → ide učiti francuski = C (On a course). Otac ide poslovno, ali Charlie ide radi tečaja.

r11.exp: 'My home town in GREECE' → Michalis je grčke nacionalnosti = Greek.

r12.exp: 'Washington Symphony Orchestra' + 'debut concert' + piano = pijanist = pianist.

r13.exp: 'Released as a CD the following year, in 2007' → debitantski koncert bio je GODINU PRIJE = 2006.

r14.exp: 'Friends shortened it to MIKEY' → nadimak je Mikey.

r15.exp: 'I do PHOTOGRAPHY. It's a good excuse to get me out of my apartment.' → hobi je fotografija.

r16.exp: 'Half of the 93% is (16)___. Its TONE can totally change the meaning.' → C: what you do with your voice. Ton glasa = glas.

r17.exp: 'Gestures (17)___.' → D: that your face, hands and body make. Geste = pokreti lica, ruku i tijela.

r18.exp: 'Try saying the same thing several times (18)___. This can change meaning considerably.' → F: while you do different things with face, hands and body. Isti tekst + različita tjelesna govor = različito značenje.

r19.exp: 'Touching your hair (19)___.' → B: can show you are insecure. Dodirivanje kose = znak nesigurnosti.

r20.exp: 'Body language and voice tell you (20)___. This is how you find out about FEELINGS and THOUGHTS.' → E: whether he or she is attracted to you or not. Govor tijela otkriva osjećaje, uključujući privlačnost.

r21.exp: 'I HAVE NEVER HAD a girlfriend' — present perfect za iskustvo: have + never + past participle.

r22.exp: 'Most people think I'm good looking, WHICH can seem strange' — 'which' u ne-restriktivnoj relativnoj surečenici (uz zarez, odnosi se na cijelu prethodnu rečenicu).

r23.exp: 'Have MADE no difference' — fiksna kolokacija: make a difference (ne 'do' niti 'have').

r24.exp: 'Books ON confidence, dating and seduction' — prijedlog 'on' uz temu knjige: a book on (o nečemu).

r25.exp: 'I dress WELL' — prilog 'well' modificira glagol 'dress' (dobro se oblačim). 'Good' je pridjev, ne prilog.

r26.exp: 'Take UP a sport' — frazalni glagol: take up = početi se baviti (sportom).

r27.exp: 'Relaxing and AT the same time energetic' — fiksni izraz: at the same time = istovremeno.

r28.exp: 'What can it DO for you?' — fiksna kolokacija: what can X do for you (što može X učiniti za tebe).

r29.exp: 'It's SO good for the body that...' — rezultatna konstrukcija: so + adjective + that.

r30.exp: 'Pedal quickly WITHOUT causing damage' — 'without' + gerund = bez uzrokovanja štete.

sol.rubric: Odgovori na sva 3 pitanja: (1) kamo ćeš ići ovog ljeta, (2) koliko dugo ćeš ostati, (3) što ćeš raditi. Dužina 40–60 riječi (kratki format — 2012. ispit). Neformalan registar, budućno vrijeme (will/going to).

w1.exp: Pisani zadatak — nema jednog točnog odgovora. Ocjenjuju se sadržaj (odgovori na sva pitanja), jezik i dužina (40–60 riječi). Isti kratki format kao 2013. ispit.

l1.exp: Prema rekonstruiranom ključu: 1=E, 2=D, 3=B, 4=F, 5=C. (Audio-based task — odgovori su rekonstruirani.)
